name: @underload/nexus
description: Outbound-dial inference broker: a Rust (axum + tokio) hub that queues consumer jobs and streams results back over one persistent worker connection.
#main: The wasm-bindgen CommonJS glue, not the .wasm: `require('@underload/nexus')` must load bindings, and Node cannot require a raw .wasm. `scripts/build-wasm.mjs` also writes `pkg/package.json` with `type: commonjs`, because this package is `type: module` and the generated glue uses `module.exports`.

scripts.#toolchain: Every Rust script runs the pinned toolchain via `rustup run` when rustup is present; see README 'Verification status' for this host.
scripts.verify: yarn fmt:check && yarn clippy && yarn test && yarn build && yarn build:wasm && yarn smoke:wasm
